concepts.name: Theory Of Production And Cost 51 Margina
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 3: Theory of Production and Cost 51 Marginal Product (MP): The marginal product (MP) is the extra or additional output obtained with one extra unit of the variable input while all other variables remain constant
concepts.deep_explanation: In other words, the MP is the percentage change in total output resulting from a percentage change in variable input, all other things being equal
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Theory of Production and Cost 51 Margina from page 59.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Theory of Production and Cost 51 Margina with adjacent topics in Chapter 3.
